scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.mjs && npm install && npm install --prefix ott && npm install --prefix dsg && npm install --prefix dsg/backend
scripts.google:apply: docker compose up -d worker && docker compose exec worker ak apply_blueprint vyoma/google-source.yaml
scripts.db:init: npm run db:push --prefix ott && npm run db:seed --prefix ott && npm run seed --prefix dsg/backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ott && npm run build --prefix dsg
scripts.start: concurrently -n ott,dsg-api,dsg -c magenta,green,yellow "npm start --prefix ott" "npm start --prefix dsg/backend" "npm run preview --prefix dsg"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ott,dsg-api,dsg -c magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix ott" "npm run dev --prefix dsg/backend" "npm run dev --prefix dsg"
